# Connecting Dots
> AI and cloud-native engineering blog by Harsha — practitioner-led posts on enterprise AI adoption, LLMOps, agent architecture, and the patterns that actually matter in production.

## Author
Harsha — Cloud Native Developer and AI Engineer. About: https://sriharshacr.github.io/sriharshacr/
